title: request_gateway_restart: absolutize data/agents for detached child
summary: The verified gateway restart helper spawns a detached child with cwd="/". Callers passing relative data/agents paths silently failed: the child could not find the data dir, the report stayed "requested" forever, and gateway_request_unresolved blocked future restarts. Production update paths already pass absolute paths, but ad-hoc recovery invocations do not. request_gateway_restart now absolutizes both arguments before writing the report and building argv.
verification: tests/meta/test_gateway_restart_auto_request.py (34 tests incl. new relative-path case), tests/meta/test_mcs_recover.py, tests/meta/test_recovery_bundle_distribution.py, tests/ingest/test_health_recovery_gateway.py — 197 passed
notes: SUPPORT_FILES pin for mcs_recovery_gateway.py refreshed in mcs_recover.py as required by the pinned-source loader.
